name: Rho guanine nucleotide exchange factor 12
pathways: regulation of small GTPase mediated signal transduction

function.text: ARHGEF12 encodes rho guanine nucleotide exchange factor 12. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activator activity and guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. It participates in Rho protein signal transduction and regulation of small GTPase mediated signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: ARHGEF12 has been described as a fusion partner in acute myeloid leukemia.
